title: Decision 14: the Incarlopsa ham piece is sold by the kilo
keys: Each product is keyed as it stood at the start of the stage of plan 0192 that changed it (the items-snapshot of that stage). A product that a stage created is keyed as the create answered it. Each queue row is keyed as it stood at the start of stage 1 (stage-c1/rows-snapshot.c0-start.json).

entries.ownerDecision: Decided by the owner, 2026-10-06: KILOGRAM with no size if its row is sold by weight. Else left.
entries.why: its only row (Mercadona 40be5d70, ext 58293) says soldByWeight true and no size, and the current price of each of the three warehouses is 9.56 = 9.56 per kg
